_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); discount-retail signals

pit_profile.why: Walmart: 'helps people around the world save money and live better – anytime and anywhere – in retail stores or through our e-commerce and mobile capabilities'; 'everyday low prices ("EDLP")'; 'The retail business is highly competitive' ('We face strong competition from other retailers and wholesale club operators (whether through physical retail, digital retail or through a combination of both areas), which could materially adversely affect our financial performance'); and 'General economic conditions, globally or in one or more of the markets we serve, may adversely affect our financial performance' (its own FY2015 10-K): a low-price store network whose demand follows the consumer economy by its own account; ECOMMERCE is live (from 2015-01-01) and its competition risk factor puts it on the watch list: company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Walmart

theme_watch.reason: Live: Walmart's own FY2015 10-K says 'We face strong competition from other retailers and wholesale club operators (whether through physical retail, digital retail or through a combination of both areas), which could materially adversely affect our financial performance.' At the same time it sells online itself: 'E-commerce sales positively impacted comparable sales approximately 0.3% and 0.2% for Walmart U.S. and Sam's Club, respectively, for the fiscal year ended January 31, 2015'. The stock trades at 13.3x FY16E — a discount to its own history. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (ECOMMERCE) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing online substitution of Walmart's store sales specifically.

classification.quality_note: Walmart: 'helps people around the world save money and live better – anytime and anywhere – in retail stores or through our e-commerce and mobile capabilities'; 'everyday low prices ("EDLP")'; 'The retail business is highly competitive' ('We face strong competition from other retailers and wholesale club operators (whether through physical retail, digital retail or through a combination of both areas), which could materially adversely affect our financial performance'); and 'General economic conditions, globally or in one or more of the markets we serve, may adversely affect our financial performance' (its own FY2015 10-K): a low-price store network whose demand follows the consumer economy by its own account; ECOMMERCE is live (from 2015-01-01) and its competition risk factor puts it on the watch list: company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Walmart. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 0.28x; +2% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.82; conservative 2yr +20%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -0.8%/yr (worst year FY06-FY15, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +5.9%/yr (FY16 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +7.2%/yr (FY06-FY15 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +11.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY06-FY15); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: WMT (retrospective, 2015-12-24) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.28x (9.6% downside to Bear $55 / +34.8% upside to Bull $82) | Adj composite 1.89 vs market 2.71: gap -0.82 [OVERVALUED] | +2% above the EPP floor $59 (13x FY16E $4.58) | Conservative 2-yr case: +20.3% total (+10.1%/yr) | At 13.3x FY16E the 15% hurdle price $80 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; U.S. comps +0.7% in Q3 FY16, forward sales +3% (FY16 net sales guide excluding currency); e-commerce competition is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
